summary: The marketing team is in execution mode on two fronts — program promotion and the Knowledge website redesign — while a minor Outlook lockout has briefly diverted attention.
summaryDetail: The top priority right now is the promotion push for Asia Star and Intelligent China (with Berkeley as a possible third), where conversion tracking setup and a search-visibility audit are the gating items that need to move this week. The Knowledge website redesign has settled on a direction — keep the current design, improve menu categorization, disperse videos by topic, and surface BCI/BSI index banners — with Joseph's editorial layout as inspiration only; design changes and a 30-minute feedback-marking session are pending. Urgent this week: resolve the Outlook account lockout (re-add accounts, update passwords across devices, confirm with CKGSB IT) and kick off promotion for the 2026 Women in Leadership Forum now that speakers are confirmed and registration is open. Coming up: the website redesign PPT/email to Zongchao must wait until the homepage launches and both URLs are live, and several November items (YouTube edit plan for 233 videos, revised faculty speech topic, Western MBA press release) are queued for review. A cluster of owner-specific follow-ups — Joseph's search-visibility prompts document and design HTML, plus the CRM/participant profile analysis — should be tracked so the promotion work isn't blocked.

decisions.text: Use the new password across all devices to prevent repeated account lockouts
Keep the current Knowledge design rather than a full revamp, with menu categorization as the main improvement.
Remove the standalone videos section and disperse videos by topic across the site.
Bring BCI (and BSI) index banners into the Knowledge section, similar to the school homepage.
Do not add a stock-market ticker at the top of the homepage.
Use Joseph's design as inspiration for displaying more articles and surfacing indices, not to be followed exactly.
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for promotion
Consider Berkeley program as a third priority for promotion
Put US partnership programs on hold initially
Wait until the homepage is launched before sending the website redesign PPT and email to Zongchao, and include both website URLs.
